div.div: سَاجِسِىٌّ A ram having much wool: fem. with ة: (A:) or a ram having white wool, good for tupping, or covering, and of excellent breed. (K, * (TA.) And Certain sheep [i. e. a breed of sheep] belonging to the Benoo-Teghlib, (K, * TA,) in El-Jezeereh. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
